item.title: UConn Basketball Sets 2026 Women’s Champions Classic Clash with Maryland
item.description: UConn basketball will face Maryland in the 2026 Women's Champions Classic, as the Huskies ride a 2-0 record into the annual Brooklyn event. The post UConn Basketball Sets 2026 Women’s Champions Classic Clash with Maryland appeared first on Just Women's Sports.

item.title: Six Iranian Women’s Football Players Remain in Australia with Asylum as Team Returns to Iran
item.description: Six members of Iran's women's national team received asylum in Australia, while the rest of the team departed from Sydney Airport this week. The post Six Iranian Women’s Football Players Remain in Australia with Asylum as Team Returns to Iran appeared first on Just Women's Sports.

item.title: ESPN Gains Exclusive Broadcast Rights to 2026 NCAA Women’s Hockey Tournament
item.description: ESPN and ESPN+ will exclusively air the 2026 NCAA Women's Ice Hockey Championship, with the championship set for March 22nd on ESPNU. The post ESPN Gains Exclusive Broadcast Rights to 2026 NCAA Women’s Hockey Tournament appeared first on Just Women's Sports.

item.title: No. 6 Toledo Upsets No. 3 UMass Basketball 67-56 in MAC Tournament Quarterfinals
item.description: No. 3 UMass basketball fell to No. 6 Toledo 67-56 in the 2026 MAC Tournament quarterfinals this week, in the NCAA's latest mid-major upset. The post No. 6 Toledo Upsets No. 3 UMass Basketball 67-56 in MAC Tournament Quarterfinals appeared first on Just Women's Sports.

item.title: Can Big East Tournament Winner UConn Secure the No. 1 NCAA Tournament Seed?
item.description: UConn won its sixth straight Big East Tournament on Monday — but is it enough to secure the No. 1 overall seed at the 2026 NCAA tournament? The post Can Big East Tournament Winner UConn Secure the No. 1 NCAA Tournament Seed? appeared first on Just Women's Sports.

item.title: Caitlin Clark Lifts Team USA Over Senegal in National Team Debut
item.description: In her first game in nearly eight months, Caitlin Clark posted a double-double against Senegal while making her USA Basketball debut on Wednesday. The post Caitlin Clark Lifts Team USA Over Senegal in National Team Debut appeared first on Just Women's Sports.

item.title: Top Seeds Advance to 2026 Indian Wells Quarterfinals
item.description: Top tennis stars are rolling at Indian Wells, as six Top 10 WTA athletes advanced to the 2026 BNP Paribas Open quarterfinals in California. The post Top Seeds Advance to 2026 Indian Wells Quarterfinals appeared first on Just Women's Sports.

item.title: PWHL Takeover Tour Stop Scores League’s 1st-Ever National U.S. Broadcast
item.description: The PWHL will see its first-ever game earn a national US broadcast on March 28th, when ION airs the league's Detroit tour stop between New York and Montréal. The post PWHL Takeover Tour Stop Scores League’s 1st-Ever National U.S. Broadcast appeared first on Just Women's Sports.

item.title: Top NCAA Women’s Ice Hockey Teams Skate Toward 2026 Frozen Four
item.description: The 2026 Division I women's ice hockey tournament kicks off on Thursday, with 11 of the top NCAA teams vying for spots in this year's Frozen Four. The post Top NCAA Women’s Ice Hockey Teams Skate Toward 2026 Frozen Four appeared first on Just Women's Sports.

item.title: NWSL Drops 2026 Season Rule Changes, Future Expansion Plans
item.description: The 2026 NWSL season kicks off on Friday, as the league unveils rule changes as well as ongoing expansion plans before hitting the pitch. The post NWSL Drops 2026 Season Rule Changes, Future Expansion Plans appeared first on Just Women's Sports.
